attchmntText: SVP GLOBAL TEXTILES LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SVP Global Textiles Limited approved un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company did not prepare consolidated financial results. This decision follows the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process initiated against wholly owned subsidiary Shrivallabh Pittie Enterprises Private Limited. The National Company Law Tribunal passed an order on September 03, 2026. The Resolution Professional has not provided requisite financial information. Downstream subsidiaries are also under the Resolution Professional's control. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report. The report highlights the inability to comment on financial impacts due to confidential insolvency proceedings. It also notes uncertainty regarding the recoverability of advances and receivables. The board meeting concluded at 4:00 P.M. on November 09, 2026.
